# 🎩 Alfred Plex
✨ *Browse and perform actions on your plex media servers* ✨
## 🧰 Requirements
* **Python 3.10 or above** (`brew install python`). Check with `python3 --version`. * Optional: VLC / IINA (`brew install --cask vlc iina`) or Infuse to stream medias.
## 🧙‍♂️ Invoke the workflow
* `plex`: main menu (configurable). * New here? Open **Plex Help › Getting Started**.
1. 🔎 **Plex Search**: type to search your servers; empty, it lists your libraries to browse them as **posters** (Grid View), sorted and filtered by picking. ⏎ on a media opens all its actions (play, mark played, rate, playlists, collections, files, download, delete...). 2. 🧭 **Plex Discover**: movies, shows and people on Plex Discover. 3. 👥 **Plex Accounts**: sign in with Plex, users, devices (clean up old ones), watchlist. 4. 🖥️ **Plex Media Servers**: sessions, recently added, libraries, statistics, settings, maintenance. 5. 🎛️ **Plex Presets**: saved searches (save one from the last row of Plex Search). 6. 🛟 **Plex Help**: shortcuts, filters & sorts, alias, cache, logs export.
📤 CSV exports (libraries, history, plays, bandwidth, devices, watchlist, settings...) go to your downloads folder.
**Results view** (configuration): ☰ list without images (default), 🖼️ list with posters, or ▦ grid (same search and shortcuts, results as posters). Posters stay in the Alfred cache: **Plex Help › Workflow Cache & Logs › 🖼️ Posters** purges them all or one by one.
**→ on a media**, then ↩ on **Plex**: full details by default (configurable: more details, actions page, play, Plex Web). ⎋ or Return goes back.
**Navigation**: every screen has a *Return* row that goes back to the screen you came from (⌘⏎ main menu). Alfred stays open on a ⏳ loading page while an action runs.
## 🧩 How the diagram works
Every row of the workflow sets `{var:action}`: the **Router** sends it to a page (`browse`, `search`, `discover`), posters (`grid` → Grid View), a media sheet (`details` → Text View), a prompt (`ask`), a background command (`run` → `python3 main.py run`), a web page, Finder or another workflow. A command picks the next step through the `dispatch` trigger; long commands and errors end with a macOS notification (Post Notification output). Untick `🔔 Notifications` to keep the workflow silent.
Full documentation on [GitHub](https://github.com/BenjaminOddou/alfred-plex).
